# Soham Jariwala

> Soham Jariwala is a fifth-generation diamontaire and jeweler, and a founder and engineer building AI and blockchain infrastructure for the physical economy: the diamond and rare-metal trade, jewelry, and the private equity that moves it. By 19 he had personally sold $1.7M in loose diamonds and $200K in jewelry. This is his official personal website, soham-jariwala.com.

## Who is Soham Jariwala

Soham Jariwala is the incoming MLE at KARA (YC's first diamond startup), co-founder and CEO of Jewel Labs, and CIO at KOOV. He studies computer science at Cornell University and researches integrated quantum photonics for NV-center-based diamond fingerprinting at Carnegie Mellon University.

## Roles

- Incoming MLE, KARA (YC's first diamond startup): AI optimization layer for semiconductor manufacturing and Microwave Plasma CVD diamond research. https://karalabs.ai
- Co-founder and CEO, Jewel Labs: agentic AI infrastructure for the global rare-metal, jewelry, and diamond trade. Launched with over 100 letters of intent and a 350+ waitlist; builds fine-tuned models for Fortune 1000 houses. https://jewellabs.org
- Chief Information Officer, KOOV: AI company serving Indian finance and industry, including JM Financial. https://koovai.com
- Technical Research Assistant, Carnegie Mellon University: integrated quantum photonics for NV-center-based fingerprinting of diamonds, toward blockchain-anchored anti-counterfeiting and provenance verification.

## Education

- Cornell University, College of Arts and Sciences: B.A. Computer Science and Economics.

## Recognition

- KARA, YC's first diamond startup (incoming machine learning engineer).
- Forbes 30 Under 30, awarded to 504 Found, the nonprofit where Soham served as CXO.
- Published IEEE preprint research on CNN-based crop health monitoring (2,000+ views).
